item.title: Independence City Council narrows field in search for city manager
item.description: Amid the months of candidate campaigns for upcoming municipal elections in Independence, the City Council has also done a search for the next city manager – a process that started after Zach Walker left the Independence in October for a similar position in Bloomington, Minnesota. Council Member Bridget McCandless, who led a small recruitment committee of council members when the search started, said earlier this month the council has worked to narrow the candidate list to three or four finalists

item.title: Jackson County tax issues will affect schools
item.description: Jackson County Executive Phil LeVota says the county is still sorting out property tax issues. He acknowledges that caps on assessment increases as well as credits to homeowners for overpayments after the 2023 assessments will hurt schools, fire districts and others. The post Jackson County tax issues will affect schools appeared first on The Examiner.
